description: This file contains a utility class `ShareUtils` that wraps functionalities provided by the `share_plus` package. It offers methods to share files and text content via native OS share sheets.

classes.name: ShareUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing methods to share files and text via native share sheets.

methods.name: shareFiles
methods.description: Shares a list of file paths using the device's native share sheet.

methods.name: shareText
methods.description: Shares plain text content via the device's share sheet.
